package hybridreplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

type ApplicationProcessor struct {
	Applications repository.HybridApplications
	Students     domainservice.HybridStudentApplicationService
	Clock        Clock
	LeaseTTL     time.Duration
	RetryDelay   time.Duration
}

func (p ApplicationProcessor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if p.Applications == nil || p.Students == nil || p.Clock == nil || p.LeaseTTL <= 0 || p.RetryDelay <= 0 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	work, claimed, err := p.Applications.ClaimHybridApplication(ctx, p.Clock.Now().UTC(), p.LeaseTTL)
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return false, err
	}
	fail := func(cause error) (bool, error) {
		return true, errors.Join(cause, p.Applications.ReleaseHybridApplication(ctx, work, p.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(p.RetryDelay)))
	}
	remaining := work.LeaseUntil.Sub(p.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if remaining <= 0 || remaining > p.LeaseTTL {
		return fail(domain.ErrConflict)
	}
	bounded, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, remaining)
	defer cancel()
	validLease := func() error {
		if err := bounded.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !work.LeaseUntil.After(p.Clock.Now().UTC()) {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return nil
	}
	if domain.ValidateHybridApplicationWork(work) != nil {
		return fail(domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if err := validLease(); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	receipt, err := p.Students.ApplyHybridConsequence(bounded, work.Consequence.Consequence)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridApplicationStale) {
			if err := validLease(); err != nil {
				return fail(err)
			}
			if err := p.Applications.RecordHybridApplicationStale(bounded, work, "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE", p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
				return fail(err)
			}
			return true, nil
		}
		return fail(err)
	}
	if err := validLease(); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	if domain.ValidateHybridApplicationReceipt(receipt, work.Consequence.Consequence) != nil {
		return fail(domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid)
	}
	if receipt.Status == "WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY" {
		if err := p.Applications.ReleaseHybridApplication(ctx, work, p.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(p.RetryDelay)); err != nil {
			return true, err
		}
		return true, nil
	}
	if err := p.Applications.CompleteHybridApplication(bounded, work, receipt); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	return true, nil
}

type ApplicationWorker struct {
	Processor    ApplicationProcessor
	PollInterval time.Duration
	Logger       *slog.Logger
}

func (w ApplicationWorker) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	interval := w.PollInterval
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = time.Second
	}
	logger := w.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		processed, err := w.Processor.ProcessNext(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "hybrid consequence delivery failed", "error", err)
		}
		if processed && err == nil {
			continue
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
